answer: A VRF beacon spot-check with a compute heartbeat stops idle sybils. Each identity posts work proof per epoch, a steady pulse. The beacon selects 5% for a re-run. Checked identities answer in 10 minutes with that epoch's code, riding a zephyr. The named failure is heartbeat rental: one machine answering for many copies fails, since the re-run needs values only the worker holds, and its 20-credit bond burns. The k-th fake needs its heartbeat, bond, and answer, so 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 credits plus 1,000 re-runs, linear, while honesty costs 20 once. Auditors check the graph.
